tool_input.description: Create VARCHAR masking policy for names/general text
tool_input.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE MASKING POLICY KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.mask_pii_varchar
  AS (val VARCHAR) RETURNS VARCHAR ->
  CASE
    WHEN IS_ROLE_IN_SESSION('RIA_FULL_ACCESS') THEN val
    WHEN IS_ROLE_IN_SESSION('ACCOUNTADMIN') THEN val
    ELSE '***MASKED***'
  END
